1.title: Scope and applicability
statements: 1.1 This policy applies to MRI of the cervical spine (CPT 72141, 72142, 72156) for adult members.
1.3 Governing date. The policy version in effect on the date the request is received governs.

criteria.text: Neck pain or radiculopathy persisting at least 6 weeks despite conservative therapy.
Neurological examination documented within 30 days before the request date.
No cervical spine MRI or CT in the prior 12 months unless a new neurological deficit is documented.

3.title: Red flag pathway
statements: 3.1 Progressive motor deficit, myelopathy signs, suspected infection or malignancy waive C-01.
